title: Support of a finite type quasi-coherent module: closed, and proper over the base iff the module lives on a closed subscheme proper over the base
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. (1) The support $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] is a closed subset of $X$. (2) $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ is proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base] if and only if there is a closed subscheme $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], with quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_Z\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], such that $Z\to S$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $\mathcal I_Z\mathcal F=0$ (that is, $as=0$ for all local sections $a$ of $\mathcal I_Z$ and $s$ of $\mathcal F$ over a common open; equivalently $\mathcal F=i_*\mathcal G$ for a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal G$). One may take for $Z$ the scheme-theoretic support of $\mathcal F$, the closed subscheme cut out by the annihilator ideal sheaf of $\mathcal F$, whose underlying set is $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0CYS (lemma-module-support-proper-over-base), (1)<=>(2)<=>(3), with Morphisms Lemma 056J (lemma-support-finite-type, literature/stacks-project/morphisms.tex) for closedness of the support and Morphisms Definition 05JV / Lemma 05JU (scheme-theoretic support)
